userRequest:
Fix PatchIntentService create target extraction.

Goal:
When the user request contains explicit files to create, extract those exact file paths as TargetCreatedFiles.

Example request:
Create:
Models/AgentDashboardMetrics.cs
Services/AgentDashboardMetricsService.cs
Components/Coder/AgentDashboardPanel.razor

Expected TargetCreatedFiles:
Models/AgentDashboardMetrics.cs
Services/AgentDashboardMetricsService.cs
Components/Coder/AgentDashboardPanel.razor

Do not produce:
V2.6

Review:
Services/PatchIntentService.cs
Tests around patch intent / create target extraction

Add tests:
- Extracts multiple create target paths from Create: block
- Ignores version labels like V2.6
- Preserves .cs and .razor file paths
- Requires allowed create folders

Run:
dotnet test
dotnet build
